categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Quantum-Resistant
categories.content: Quantum-resistant projects are characterised by their use of post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (e.g., hash-based, lattice-based) to remain secure against potential attacks from future quantum computers.

categories.name: Racing Games
categories.content: Racing game involves competing in races with various vehicles. These games can range from realistic simulations to arcade-style fast-paced action.

categories.name: Reality Ecosystem
categories.content: Reality is a platform by Bitget that issues tokenized real-world assets (like U.S. stocks and ETFs) backed 1:1 by securities, bringing them on-chain with stablecoin dividend payments.

categories.name: Zero Knowledge (ZK)
categories.content:
Zero-knowledge proof or Zero-knowledge protocol is a method by which one party (the prover) can prove to another party (the verifier) that a given statement is true while the prover avoids conveying any additional information apart from the fact that the statement is indeed true.

This category tracks cryptocurrency that utilises Zero Knowledge implementation to execute transactions, which may include smart contract execution, value transfer, and others.

categories.name: The Boy’s Club
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by The Boy's Club.

categories.name: Guild and Scholarship
categories.content: Guilds are decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) that invests in NFTs like game assets and rent them out to players. Players who receive rented game items are known as scholars and can be said to receive a scholarship. Guilds are an important component in the play to earn (P2E) ecosystem as these games require an upfront investment capital for players to participate in.
